content.tex: B MODELLING (QUESTIONS 5 to 7)
THE SPEED OF SOUND (30 marks)
You are advised to spend no more than 50 minutes on this part.
This task is about the speed of sound travelling through the air.
The speed of sound, \(S\) m/s, is often given as 343m/s. This means that a sound will travel 343 metres in 1 second through dry air when the temperature is 20°C.
